title: B1-16 · The lexicon of the news

blocks.text: B1-16 · The lexicon of the news
Lesson overview

In B1-15 you have learned to read the titles; You're gonna be in the articles now. Each section of a newspaper has its own small vocabulary, which repeats itself almost the same every day: in a bad weather news they always come back ⁧هُطُولُ أَمْطَارٍ غَزِيرَةٍ⁩ , ⁧فِرَقُ الإِنْقَاذِ⁩ and have not been injured, in economics ⁧مُعَدَّلُ التَّضَخُّمِ⁩ and ⁧عَجْزُ المِيزَانِيَّةِ⁩ . In this unit you learn the essential vocabulary of seven areas (politics, economy, society, accidents, weather, courts, sport), especially as placements: the verb or adjective that always accompanies a certain name. For the courts only the general lexicon of the chronicles is studied, on civil and administrative cases. All the news is invented. Two weeks.

rows: 12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 128–129), plus the EGY track

blocks.text: Materials This unit, dictionary by root, a chronicle notebook (one sheet per section), voice synthesis scripts, session with the tutor; optional: a news site in Arabic
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize the sections of an Arabic newspaper and their typical vocabulary;
2. understanding and using the most frequent placements of politics, economy and society ( ⁧أَدْلَى بِصَوْتِهِ⁩ , ⁧مُعَدَّلُ التَّضَخُّمِ⁩ , ⁧نَظَّمَ⁩
⁧اعْتِصَامًا⁩ );
3. read short news of accidents and weather and their fixed formulas ( ⁧لَقِيَ مَصْرَعَهُ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ تُسَجَّلْ إِصَابَاتٌ⁩ );
4. understanding the general vocabulary of judicial reports ( ⁧جَلْسَة⁩ , ⁧غَرَامَة⁩ , ⁧اِسْتِئْنَاف⁩ ) and sports ( ⁧تَعَادَلَ⁩ , ⁧تَأَهَّلَ⁩ , ⁧هَزِيمَة⁩ );
5. organize the vocabulary for roots and for placements in a notebook of the chronicle.
Two-week plan.

1. Dialogue 1 · The secret of Karīm
Coffee break at the police station. Karīm He reads the news on the phone.

rows: Good morning. Karīm! What are you reading?
⁧الأَخْبَارَ المَغْرِبِيَّةَ، كَعَادَتِي كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ. أَبْدَأُ بِالسِّيَاسَةِ، ثُمَّ⁩ : ⁧كَرِيم⁩ ⁧الاِقْتِصَادِ، ثُمَّ الطَّقْسِ.⁩
Karīm: Moroccan news, like every morning. I start with politics, then the economy, then the weather.
Luke: And what is the most important news today?
⁧فِي السِّيَاسَةِ، الأَحْزَابُ تَخْتَارُ مُرَشَّحِيهَا لِلِانْتِخَابَاتِ القَادِمَةِ.⁩ : ⁧كَرِيم⁩ ⁧وَفِي الاِقْتِصَادِ، اِنْخَفَضَ مُعَدَّلُ التَّضَخُّمِ قَلِيلًا.⁩

⁧عِنْدَمَا تَرْتَفِعُ الأَسْعَارُ كُلُّهَا وَتَفْقِدُ النُّقُودُ قِيمَتَهَا. هِيَ مِنْ جِذْرِ⁩ : ⁧كَرِيم⁩ ⁧، أَيْ كَبِيرٍ جِدًّا.⁩ « ⁧ضَخْمٍ⁩ »

⁧ثُلُوجٌ عَلَى جِبَالِ الأَطْلَسِ، وَحَذَّرَتِ الأَرْصَادُ الجَوِّيَّةُ مِنْ رِيَاحٍ⁩ : ⁧كَرِيم⁩ ⁧قَوِيَّةٍ فِي الشَّمَالِ.⁩
Karīm: Snow in the Atlas Mountains, and weather service warned of strong winds in the north.
⁧كَيْفَ تَعَلَّمْتَ كُلَّ هٰذِهِ الكَلِمَاتِ؟ أَنَا أَفْهَمُ العَنَاوِينَ، لٰكِنِّي أَضِيعُ⁩ : ⁧لُوكَا⁩ ⁧فِي النَّصِّ.⁩
Luke: How did you learn all these words? I understand the titles, but I get lost in the text.
⁧السِّرُّ بَسِيطٌ: كُلُّ قِسْمٍ لَهُ كَلِمَاتُهُ. فِي الحَوَادِثِ تَتَكَرَّرُ عِشْرُونَ⁩ : ⁧كَرِيم⁩ ⁧أَوْ ثَلَاثُونَ كَلِمَةً تَقْرِيبًا، وَفِي الرِّيَاضَةِ مِثْلُهَا.⁩
Karīm: The secret is simple: each section has its own words. In the history of accidents, more or less twenty or thirty words are repeated, and in sport the same.
Luke: So I learn one section after another?

⁧نَعَمْ. اِقْرَأْ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ خَبَرَيْنِ مِنْ قِسْمٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَاكْتُبِ الكَلِمَةَ مَعَ⁩ : ⁧كَرِيم⁩ …« ⁧أَدْلَى بِصَوْتِهِ⁩ » ⁧،⁩ « ⁧اِنْدَلَعَ حَرِيقٌ⁩ » ⁧الفِعْلِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي مَعَهَا دَائِمًا:⁩
Karīm: Yes. Read daily two news of a single section, and write the word with the verb that always accompanies it: "A fire broke out," "He voted."

blocks.text: ⁧الكَلِمَةُ مَعَ صَدِيقِهَا! سَأُجَرِّبُ مِنَ اليَوْمِ.⁩ : ⁧لُوكَا⁩ The word with her friend! I'm trying today.

What to notice. The secret of Karīm has a name: placement , i.e. the fixed combination of two words (in English, a fire breaks out), does not start a fire . ⁧كَعَادَتِي⁩ As usual, as my custom. ⁧أَضِيعُ⁩ I'm losing it. ⁧ضَاعَ⁩ , A2). ⁧ضَخْم⁩ Huge: ⁧تَضَخُّم⁩ is the maṣdar of the V form, ... ⁧جِبَالُ الأَطْلَسِ⁩ The Atlas Mountains.
2. The sections of the newspaper
Arab news sites divide news into sections with fairly stable names. Learn to recognize them in the menu.
Three rules for the notebook.
1. For roots. A root gives many words in the same section: ⁧ن خ ب⁩ gives ⁧اِنْتَخَبَ⁩ "Elect' means: ⁧اِنْتِخَابَات⁩
• elections • ⁧نَاخِب⁩ ... ⁧مُنْتَخَب⁩ The team shall be elected and the national team shall also be elected.
2. For placements. Always write the name with his verb: ⁧اِنْدَلَعَ حَرِيقٌ⁩ , ⁧أَخْمَدَ الحَرِيقَ⁩ , ⁧أَدْلَى بِصَوْتِهِ⁩ , ⁧سَجَّلَ هَدَفًا.⁩
3. For fixed formulas. Some sentences are identical: ⁧لَمْ تُسَجَّلْ أَيُّ إِصَابَاتٍ⁩ There were no injuries.
Learn them whole.

Luca: Laylā! I saw you yesterday on the news in the rain!
⁧نَعَمْ، كُنْتُ فِي قَرْيَةٍ فِي الجَبَلِ. ضَرَبَتِ المِنْطَقَةَ عَاصِفَةٌ قَوِيَّةٌ.⁩ : ⁧لَيْلَى⁩

10. Pronunciation

The waṣla of maṣdar VIII and X. ⁧اِقْتِرَاع⁩ , ⁧اِعْتِصَام⁩ , ⁧اِسْتِثْمَار⁩ they lose the i after the article or a word that ends in vowel: ṣanādīqu l-iqtirāʿ, fī l-istiṯmārāt, naẓẓama ʿtiṣāman. The hamza in the middle. ⁧اِسْتِئْنَاف⁩ : istiʾnāf, with a small detachment before no. Don't say istināf. ⁧ض⁩ and ⁧ظ⁩ , ⁧ص⁩ and ⁧س⁩ . ⁧تَضَخُّم⁩ , ⁧ضَبَاب⁩ , ⁧أَصْدَرَ⁩ , ⁧صَادِرَات⁩ : The emphasis gives the dark color to the whole word. Those who listen to a news bulletin often recognize these words precisely from the color of the vowels.
